item.name: Cheese_of_the_Day
item.description: Cheese selected on the current pairing list from an approved food source.
item.readyBeforeUse: The cheese is protected from contamination and at or below 41°F.
item.readyForNextPerson: During service, the cheese is protected and at or below 41°F. After service, protected cheese held at or below 41°F is wrapped and refrigerated. Exposed cheese or cheese with unknown history is discarded.
item.ifNotReady: Keep the cheese out of service and tell the Food Lead.
